blocks.h2: When to Call for Drain Cleaning
blocks.body: Call when plunging hasn't fixed it, when the same drain clogs again within weeks or when a drain smells like sewer. Pay attention to how many fixtures are affected. One slow drain usually means a clog close to it. If the floor drain fills when the washer empties or the toilet gurgles when the tub drains, the main line is blocked, and that's [sewer rodding](/geneva/sewer-rodding).

img.alt: Illustration of common signs a drain needs professional cleaning

bodies: Everyday use causes most clogs: hair and soap in bathrooms, grease and food in kitchens, lint from laundry. We clear them with a cable sized for the pipe and show you what came out.

In Geneva's historic homes, old galvanized and cast iron drains have rough insides that catch debris and clog again quickly. In newer homes, long runs with lots of turns are where clogs settle. If the same drain keeps clogging, a camera look tells us whether it needs [hydro jetting](/geneva/hydro-jetting) or a repair.
Grease causes most kitchen clogs. It goes down warm and hardens in the pipe, catching food and soap.

If both bowls fill or the dishwasher drains into the sink, the clog is past the trap. We clear the line to the stack. Disposal involved? See [garbage disposal repair](/geneva/garbage-disposal-installation-repair).

blocks.h2: Why Drains Clog in Geneva Homes
blocks.intro: Geneva's homes range from the 1840s to today, and drain problems follow their age.

items.body: Galvanized and cast iron drains in older homes narrow over time, so clogs come back faster.
A new kitchen often sits on top of the original drain line, which still has decades of buildup.
Several slow drains at once usually mean roots or a blockage in the main. That's [sewer drain clearing](#sewer-drain-clearing).

bodies: When every drain slows down together or the basement floor drain fills, the main sewer drain is blocked. Clearing it takes a machine that can run the full line from the cleanout to the main.

We clear the line, then camera it so you see the cause. Near downtown, it's usually roots in old clay. On the west side, it's more often grease, wipes or a sag. Repeat clogs get a plan: [sewer rodding](/geneva/sewer-rodding), [hydro jetting](/geneva/hydro-jetting) or a [sewer repair](/geneva/sewer-repair).

blocks.h2: Drain Cleaning Questions From Geneva Homeowners

items.q: Do you offer emergency drain cleaning in Geneva?
items.answer: Yes. If a drain backs up at night or on a weekend, call us any time and we'll get a plumber to you as soon as we can.

items.q: Why does my old house have so many clogs?
items.preview: Old pipe is rough inside and catches debris.
items.answer: Old galvanized and cast iron pipe is rough and narrowed inside, so it catches hair, grease and debris faster than new pipe. Jetting or replacing the worst sections helps.

items.q: Is it one drain or the main line?
items.preview: One fixture is local. Several, or the floor drain, is the main.
items.answer: If only one fixture is slow, the clog is nearby. If several are slow or the floor drain backs up, it's the main line.

items.q: Should I use a chemical drain cleaner?
items.preview: We don't recommend it, especially on old pipe.
items.answer: We don't recommend it. Chemicals can damage older pipes and rarely clear the whole clog.

items.q: How much does drain cleaning cost in Geneva?
items.preview: It depends on where the clog is. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on where the clog is and what's causing it. You'll approve a flat price before we start.
